title: Cosmic Vortex Spiral
description: A swirling vortex tunnel composed of layered, textured brushstrokes in deep blues and earthy browns spirals inward toward a glowing orange center. Small luminous yellow and white specks are scattered along the swirling bands against a dark, mottled background.
